title: Entries of a read segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and let $a,n,i\in\mathbb N$ with $i<n$. The entry at index $i$ of the length-$n$ list of values $\mu(a),\mu(a+1),\ldots,\mu(a+n-1)$ is $\mu(a+i)$.
